:= by
  have h_exp : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) = Real.exp ∘ (fun ω => t * X ω) ω := rfl
  let f := fun ω => t * X ω
  have hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ :=
    by
      rw [Real.mul]
      apply MeasureTheory.aemul
      exact hX
  have hexp : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (Real.exp ∘ f) μ :=
    by
      apply MeasureTheory.ae_strongly_measurable_comp
      exact hf
      exact MeasureTheory.ae_strongly_measurable_exp
  exact hexp
